The dual nature of schema validation and artifact regeneration forms a feedback loop where typecheck failures (F_fail) trigger regeneration (A_gen), which then revalidates the schema. This creates a dynamic system with two regimes: stable (F_fail ≤ 0.5) and unstable (F_fail > 0.5). The exit codes E_exit serve as observables for system health. In GSI, this maps to Bayesian inference over schema consistency; in GSE, it maps to state transitions based on artifact validity. The system exhibits a duality between static validation and dynamic regeneration, with failure modes manifesting as divergent log streams.
